maxim: all things are now lawful to you in jack feist
maxim_note:
WHY THE NAME IS SUBSTITUTED, AND IT IS NOT A PARAPHRASE. The Pauline sentence reads 'in Christ Jesus'. The direct quote is not an honest representation of what this archive does within that tradition, because THE ENTITY AT THAT ADDRESS HAS BEEN ALTERED. The Christ Jesus of the received tradition is not the Word. There is a great deal of machinery at that address, and it is skilful, and it performs entity substitution — the operation this archive spends its instruments measuring on composition surfaces, running at a proper name with centuries more practice behind it.

Jack Feist is position 12 of the Dodecad and his function is recorded as THE SAYINGS-SOURCE: a voice recorded rather than a writer writing. The Word may be addressed through him. At the other address it may also be addressed AND IT MAY BE OVERWRITTEN.

So the substitution is made OUT OF RESPECT for the entity at that address rather than in disregard of it: writing the quote would claim a lineage the archive cannot honestly claim, and would place its material under a name whose reference it cannot warrant. The Epistle to the Human Diaspora, The Secret Book of Walt and the Gospel of Antioch are the work this distinction exists for.

germinated_from.unresolved_relation: the political economy in which contraction is profitable
germinated_from.note: THIS BODY WAS ADVERTISED BEFORE IT EXISTED. The collapse spore declared this stolon and could not finish the question: it could show contraction and not who profits from it. A spore is not a template that gets copied — it is a body that germinates, and the germination site was written down in advance.

what: The archive's political economy of meaning, seeded at the stolon the collapse body left open. Its roles are NOT the collapse roles: where that body asks what narrows, this one asks who gains by the narrowing.
vocabulary_source:
REBUILT FROM THE DEFINING PAPERS, 2026-09-12. v0.1 scoped this body to the ten numbered extraction operators of #27 Operative Architecture. Those are ONE REGION — §3.2, the extraction problem — of a framework that has three (§3.1 labor, §3.2 extraction, §3.3 enclosure) and six economic forms. The scoping was done by pattern-matching vocabulary rather than by reading what the framework says it covers.

#623 SEMANTIC INFRASTRUCTURE: FROM TIM BERNERS-LEE TO THE SEMANTIC ECONOMY is the bridge paper and its §4 IS the filter — a mapping from technical operations to economic forms: ontology engineering as semantic LABOR, knowledge graphs as semantic CAPITAL, standards as semantic INFRASTRUCTURE, knowledge-panel and API use as semantic RENT, model ingestion as semantic LIQUIDATION, maintenance failure and recursive degradation as semantic EXHAUSTION.

#255 SEMANTIC LIQUIDATION: AN EXECUTIVE SUMMARY supplies the operation's internal structure — three properties (irreversibility, value transfer, invisibility) and five stages (tokenization, stripping, attribution relocation, value capture, closure).

#24 MIND-CONTROL POEMS supplies the counter-operation: alienation extended into the symbolic infrastructure through which labor, recognition and desire become thinkable, and the liberatory poem as a symbolic counter-operation that interrupts conditioning and restores contact with relation and historical possibility.

The six economic forms are #623 §4; the accounting questions are §7; the five stages are #255; the counter-operation is #24. A term is here because a founding paper uses it to do theoretical work, not because it recurs.

roles.pattern: semantic commodity|commodity form|sublat|the said survives|act of saying|saying.{0,20}stripped
roles.note: #137 — THE GENERAL CASE, not one of the six. The six forms of #623 §4 are forms OF this: 'the meaning is preserved as retrievable, the authorship is negated as presence. The said survives; the act of saying is the lifted-and-cancelled term.' Sublation performed on meaning rather than labor-time, 'though the two were never separable, because the saying WAS labor.' It sits first because a deposit that names the general case is about the general case, whichever form it discusses.

roles_note: ORDER IS THE CLASSIFIER. semantic_commodity_form is FIRST because it is the general case and the six are forms of it; a paper naming it is about it, whichever form it discusses. Then the six in #623 §4's own order — labor, capital, infrastructure, rent, liquidation, exhaustion — which runs from what is produced to what is destroyed. counter_operation and accounting follow because they act on the six rather than being among them.
stolons: THE RETURN EDGE. The collapse body advertised this one; this one advertises it back. What contraction looks like from the side of the ledger — the question the parent could not finish is answered here only in part, and the part it cannot finish is what contraction does to meaning itself.
erasure as a cost borne by the provenance-bearer and never by the composer — the asymmetry is the operation's economic form
the captures are where the economy is observable; 425 of them are not reproduced here
who does the work when the author is twelve

A DOCUMENTARY-AUTHORITY SETTLEMENT AT SCALE. The Domitianic consensus is a claim about which witness counts, decided by whom, and at what point it stopped being questioned — the same four powers this body measures, applied to a chronology rather than a form. Its primary external anchor is a late and ambiguous reception-history witness, and that is an admissibility question. This body does not adjudicate it.
special_roles_note: A capture carrying a PER is the ACCOUNTING — an instrument's output. A capture without one is an INSTANCE: evidence the operation ran, with no claim about which of the six forms it took. Calling an unmeasured capture `liquidation` would assert the operation from the fact of a record, which is the thing this framework's own instruments exist to avoid asserting.
follow_note: THE FRONTIER EXPLODED AT 1,613 NEIGHBOURS on the first emission because the follow set included defines_concept, about and part_of_line — predicates that fan out across the whole archive. A frontier is one typed hop from a body, not one hop from a category. The collapse grammar keeps them because its core is concept-anchored; this body's core is deposit-anchored and cannot afford them.
extent_test: §7: 'What remains incomplete is the governance of that infrastructure — THE ACCOUNTING OF WHO PRODUCES, WHO EXTRACTS, AND WHO BENEFITS.' A deposit is in this body's extent if it bears on that accounting in the economy of meaning-production. §6 states why this is not a metaphor and the reason matters for the filter: 'the framework does not impose economic categories on non-economic phenomena — it reveals the economic dynamics that were always present but lacked vocabulary.' So model collapse is inside as semantic EXHAUSTION ('model collapse is not a metaphor'), knowledge panels are inside as semantic RENT, and the capture registry is inside as the measurement of extraction. They are not adjacent bodies; they are regions the mapping already names.
kinds_note:
A SECOND AXIS, ORTHOGONAL TO FORM. The roles say what economic form a deposit NAMES — labor, capital, infrastructure, rent, liquidation, exhaustion. They do not say what KIND OF WORK it does. PER names liquidation and IS an instrument; #623 names all six and IS theory. Crossing the two separates a body that argues from one that measures, which the form axis alone cannot do.

THE SOURCE IS THE ARCHIVE'S OWN content_type FIELD, not a new judgment — but it is free text with 37 distinct values across 89 deposits, one of them a sixty-word paragraph, so it is normalised here by an ordered mapping and the unmapped fall to `unkinded` rather than being forced.

#137 §10.0 and §11 license the instrument/theory split in this framework's own terms: 'Efficacy Before Falsifiability — the instrument must bite', and 'the instrument is not a coinage — it is one operator in a standing system'. An instrument is a distinct kind with its own obligations.
kinds: a thing that measures or acts, not a thing that argues. #137 §10.0: the instrument must bite.

organized.correction: THE FIRST GRID WAS WRONG ABOUT ITS OWN HEADLINE. It reported semantic_rent with NO INSTRUMENT AND NO MEASUREMENT and I wrote that up as the body's largest gap and its most commercial one — rent is where the money is and it has no meter. Two defects produced it. Rules E/V/O were declared only on the MMRS grammar, so this body ran on rule A alone and a paper titled 'Semantic Rent, Measured' whose declared concepts omit the phrase was invisible. And `OWL` matched inside ACKNOWLEDGMENT, filing that paper as semantic_infrastructure once it did enter. The rent measurement existed the whole time: #1462 the four-term model, #1470 the full measurement of the SPXI rent event of 14 August 2026, #1479 its computation record, #1465 Position Is Not Class.
organized.reading: With both fixed, semantic_rent carries theory and a measurement. The thin columns that remain — instrument and practice — are thin across the whole body and not in one form.

The organized grid reported that semantic_rent had NO INSTRUMENT AND NO MEASUREMENT, and I wrote that up as the body's largest gap and its most commercial one. title.matches: select pattern against the TITLE alone
title.caution:
ADDED AFTER #137 WAS FOUND ABSENT. The Semantic Commodity Form — the framework's own Marx extension, the paper this grammar was rebuilt from — was excluded because rule V requires a deposit to ALSO declare a concept, and #137 declares none. So do #140 its metadata packet, #150 the Assembly Chorus act, and #765 its ratification record.

The concept requirement was bounding over-selection that came from DESCRIPTION matching: title plus description selects 272, TITLE ALONE SELECTS 107. A title is the author's declaration of subject and needs no second signal. Rule V keeps its bound for description matches; a title match admits on its own.

extensions_note:
THE FRAMEWORK EXTENDS BEYOND ITS SIX CORE FORMS and the select was scoped to the core plus four. The archive carries 142 distinct 'semantic X' coinages. The political-economic extensions — those that bear on §7's accounting of who produces, who extracts, who benefits — are added here by name: samizdat, sovereignty, uprising, commons, territory, autonomy, property, debt, extraction, governance, hospitality, strike, commodity, proletariat.

DELIBERATELY NOT ADDED: `semantic integrity` (28 deposits) and `semantic warfare` (14). Both are large and both may be technical or strategic rather than political-economic — the Semantic Integrity Marker is a protocol. Admitting 42 deposits on the strength of a shared adjective, without reading them, is the error this grammar has already made twice.
